items.title: Analog Devices (ADI) Bets $1.35 Billion on Chips that Let Machines Think for Themselves
items.summary: On September 9, 2026, Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ:ADI) agreed to acquire privately held Alif Semiconductor for $1.35 billion in cash, with up to $200 million in additional contingent payments. It adds Alif’s low-power, AI-native microcontrollers and fusion processors to ADI’s portfolio of sensing, signal-processing and power-management technology. items.title: ON Semiconductor Has Cratered for 3 Months: This Wall Street Pro Remains Bullish, Citing 120% Returns for Buyers
items.summary: ON Semiconductor shed nearly half its value in three months while its peers barely flinched, yet one Wall Street analyst just doubled down with the most aggressive price target on the Street. The disconnect between the selloff and the operating data raises a question worth asking.

items.title: ON Semiconductor Stock Is Already Half Off Its High, So How Low Could A Market Shock Take It?
items.summary: ON Semiconductor (ON) stock trades near $67, about 50% below its 52-week high. It lost 43.7% over the trailing three months, ending with a 9.0% fall on September 16. Yet it is still up 38.4% over the trailing twelve months, against 15.5% for the S&P 500. The company's latest results show a business still shrinking but recovering, not one in trouble.

items.title: Can ADI's Industrial Segment Sustain Its Momentum Through 2026?
items.summary: Analog Devices' Industrial segment surges 53% year over year in fiscal Q3 2026, but intense competition and inventory trends could shape its next phase.

items.title: What Is Cadence Design Systems (CDNS) Gaining From Its New Automotive AI Audio Push?
items.summary: Cadence Design Systems (NasdaqGS:CDNS) is working with Analog Devices on new SHARC-FX automotive audio processors with AI and machine learning features. The collaboration combines Cadence DSP core technology with Analog Devices hardware to support complex audio workloads in next-generation car architectures.
